gcp.dns.queries.note: Regular queries, $0.40 per million to a billion a month and $0.20 above, counted over the billing account ("All queries are aggregated as well, regardless of zone type", priced "per 1 month / account", https://cloud.google.com/dns/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.dns.routing_policy_queries.note: Queries answered by a routing policy (weighted, geolocation, failover), the first billion a month (then $0.35 per million). By hand from https://cloud.google.com/dns/pricing: the Billing Catalog's Cloud DNS service (FA26-5236-B8B5) lists only ManagedZone and DNS Query (port 53), and Networking has no routing policy query SKU, so sync cannot check it.
